source.note: Player-supplied in-game shard milestone card screenshots captured during repo-local cost recovery.

findings: These in-game checkpoints span rows 1, 9, 14, 21, and 25 across levels 16, 20, 126, 153, and 283.

Observed screenshot costs stay in the e563-e565 range even when the currently recovered StartCost mantissas are single-digit values, so the unresolved integer lane still matters to cost magnitude recovery.
The screenshots validate that the shard card rail should stay descriptive until the final BigDouble formula is proven, but they now give row-local calibration points for testing candidate formulas.
currentBoundary: Treat these screenshot entries as in-game cost checkpoints supplied by the player, not as a closed-form formula proof by themselves.
Treat the observed cost magnitudes as evidence that the preserved integer lane is still part of the real shard cost payload or staging path.
Do not expose a computed next-cost number until a candidate formula matches these checkpoints across multiple rows and threshold bands.
